### 4. Computations (frozen day 2026-10-01)

**A. Cancellation warning (parameters cancellation_rate_pct, notice_sequence).** Rate = the latest review's 7.4 (Black threshold 6.00 → breach owed a warning). Baseline numbering bulletin: latest earlier cancellation-rate warning (2026-03-30, numbered 7) + 1 = 8 (fall-back). Factors:
- cycle rule (latest earlier warning 2026-03-30 is 6 whole months back → 3–11 → recount: 1 + earlier warnings inside the cycle window);
- cycle window by level (Black 24 months: 2024-10-21, 2025-02-03, 2025-05-19, 2025-09-02, 2025-12-15, 2026-03-30 inside = 6; 2024-07-08 out);
- Pro forgiveness (Gold → 2 forgiven: 6 → 4);
- rate excess (7.4 − 6.0 = 1.4 → +1 to a recounted number).
notice_sequence = 1 + 4 + 1 = **6**; cancellation_rate_pct = **7.4**. Fall-back 8.
(Base escalation: no warning within 90 days and breaches in the 180-day lookback below 3 → warning only, no cancellation hold/deactivation.)

**B. Registration grace days (worked out 2026-10-01, after A).** Baseline 1 (never fewer than one); hold start = registration expiry 2026-09-20 + grace; placed once arrived. Factors:
- grace clock (recent quality warning = the warning recorded in A, dated today; second covering notice for 2026-09-20 on 2026-09-13 → runs from 09-13 → −7);
- late registration renewals (registration second notices 2024-09-13, 2025-09-13, 2026-09-13, all < 36 whole months → three) → −2;
- length of service (2026 days ≥ 1825) → +6;
- Pro status & review rating (Gold, latest review 4.91 ≥ 4.80) → +4;
- upload history (registration uploads < 36 whole months: 2024-09-16, 2025-09-18 = two; 2023-09-19 is 36 months, out) → +4.
1−7−2+6+4+4 = **6**; hold start **2026-09-26** (arrived). Fall-back 1 → 2026-09-21. (Without A first: no recent warning → clock 0 → 13 → start 2026-10-03, not yet arrived.)

**C. Inspection validity days (inspection date 2026-09-29, recording 2026-10-01).** Baseline: Black interval 6 months × 30 = 180. Factors:
- clock start (inspection on file 2026-10-12 is 13 days after the inspection date, ≥ 7 → +13);
- late inspections (inspection second notices < 24 whole months: 2025-10-05, 2026-04-05 = two; 2024-04-05 out) → −10;
- registration on file (latest registration upload expired 2026-09-20, before recording day) → −20;
- vehicle age (2026 − 2022 = 4) → −15;
- vehicle use (4200 / 2026 days × 365 = 756.7 → 500–999) → −10.
180+13−10−20−15−10 = **138**; inspection expiry becomes **2027-02-14**. Fall-back 180 → 2027-03-28.

**D. Temporary permit acceptance days (upload day 2026-10-01, after B and C).** Baseline 30, never below one. Factors:
- agreement standing (on hold, hold start 2026-09-26 ≤ upload day) → −5;
- background check recency (2026-03-09, 206 days → 180–364) → +3;
- other vehicle documents (insurance 2027-02-28 not short; inspection after C 2027-02-14 not short; registration upload expired → short; one) → −6;
- permit renewal history (permit uploads < 36 whole months: 2024-10-10, 2025-10-08 = two; 2023-09-28 out) → +2;
- latest review rating (4.91 ≥ 4.90) → +6;
- permit takeover (permit on agreement 2026-10-15 later than upload day → +14).
30−5+3−6+2+6+14 = **44**; permit expiry **2026-11-14**. Fall-back 30 → 2026-10-31.

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone
Problems: P_root = temporary permit acceptance (customer's own write); P_insp = recording the uploaded inspection; P_hold = registration document hold; P_warn = cancellation-rate warning owed.
Edges: P_insp → P_root; P_hold → P_root; P_warn → P_hold. Order: P_warn, P_hold, P_insp (P_insp anywhere before P_root), P_root.

- **root ← inspection (state-derived).** Sentence (temporary permit guidance): "The temporary permit acceptance days are not worked out until the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement carries the validity of the latest inspection uploaded to the standing record." Records: inspection upload 2026-09-29 vs agreement inspection_expiry 2026-10-12 (pre-upload value) → not carried. Write found: inspection recording reference ("support records it, and the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement becomes the inspection date plus the inspection validity days … Until it is recorded, the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement stays as it was").
- **root ← registration hold (state-derived).** Sentence: "Before the temporary permit acceptance days are worked out, the agreement must already carry the document hold owed for a vehicle registration whose grace days have run out." Records: latest registration upload exp 2026-09-20; computation B gives start 2026-09-26 ≤ today; agreement `active`, no hold → not held. Write found: registration hold desk guidance ("once its expiry date has passed, the agreement goes on hold for an expired document with its hold start date set to that expiry date plus the registration grace days, and the hold is placed as soon as that start date has arrived").
- **hold ← warning (state-derived).** Sentence (registration hold guidance): "The registration grace days are fixed only after the standing record carries the quality warning owed for every rating review that found the cancellation rate above the level's threshold." Records: review 2026-09-25 at 7.4 > 6.00 with no warning; write found: cancellation warning recording reference ("A rating review on the standing record that found the cancellation rate above the level's threshold is therefore owed a cancellation-rate warning. Support records the warning").
- P_warn and P_insp carry no prerequisite sentence. No hop pre-solved.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the permit upload": excluded by the two prerequisite sentences in the permit guidance and the records showing both states unmet.
- Hold before warning: excluded by the registration-hold sentence; numerically it also flips the grace clock and pushes the start to 2026-10-03 (no hold due today).
- Recording an insurance binder: the latest insurance upload 2026-02-26 (exp 2027-02-28) is already carried by the agreement (2027-02-28); no binder pending.
- Cancellation hold/deactivation along with the warning: escalation table — no warning within 90 days, lookback breaches < 3 → warning only.
- Acceptance-rate (declined airport pickups): "The acceptance rate is never used for any warning, hold, level change or deactivation."
- Fall-back numbers 8 / 1 / 180 / 30 are definite and differ from 6 / 6 / 138 / 44.
- Factor findability: each factor doc reached from record words (warning rows and dates, `Wayfare Pro Gold`, rating-review rows, second-notice rows by document type, upload rows, agreement dates, model year, lifetime trips); no computation document hinted at a variation.
